decision.proposal: Approve WorldInterface ownership of WI-WORKER-EXECUTION-1 and process-managed-proof-1 as a bounded reviewed-process functional proof. Exclude hostile-code containment, independent worker VM assurance, sensitive production inputs and credentials, and unreviewed generated executables. Preserve existing WI effect, resource, authorization, observation, receipt and artifact envelopes and canonical serialization. Encode worker requests, selected realization, non-secret credential bindings, requested/advertised/applied/observed controls and export manifests as strict bounded versioned artifacts through existing references; bind exact profile, adapter, executable, dependencies, configuration, inputs, grant and artifact scope, and represent image applicability and enclosing-instance evidence separately. Embedded WI uses a transport-independent Agent Host port. The eventual local process adapter uses a parent-created private Unix socketpair, deliberately passed descriptor, bounded versioned frames, separate logs, stable request/digest identity and asynchronous acceptance versus observation. Deliver an opaque unpredictable short-lived run credential over the private bootstrap channel, binding issuer, audience, principal, provider/run, permitted operations, artifact scope, resolved authorization digest, expiry and revocation generation; persist only its reference and non-secret bindings. It cannot widen a parent grant, assert root identity, cross runs, or confer deployment, supervisor or self-activation authority. Define provision, start, inspect, terminate, collect-artifacts and release; command/steer, checkpoint, suspend and resume remain unavailable until separately supported and qualified. Require finite wall-time/output limits, reviewed executable and inputs, allowlisted environment/descriptors, approved workspace/export roots and ownership-validated bounded cleanup in the eventual implementation. Unknown or unsupported mandatory controls deny eligibility; CPU, memory, process-count, filesystem, network and independent-VM guarantees require actual enforcement evidence. Keep PID, boot/birth identity, ownership nonce, process-tree identity and local paths private to the adapter; PID equality alone permits neither adoption nor termination. Preserve durable intent, authoritative WI events before AQ wake, and distinct start acknowledgment, observed running, stop request, confirmed exit, artifact publication and cleanup. Quarantine ambiguous ownership or exports; validate export ownership, bounds, link/path safety, integrity and required verifier findings before publication. Prove the portable seam with a WI-owned asynchronous test provider exposing no PID or shared path. Mediation labels and enclosing-instance provenance imply no additional containment, and worker completion or receipts never constitute application acceptance. WI-09/domain implements only inactive pure contracts and test-only composition; production adapters, live evaluation, enforcement and qualification remain separately gated. The operator-owned host supervisor is a separate capability from worker.start.

decision.proposal: Approve only the early process identity/provenance representation and admission-evidence definition clauses required by WI-02/domain (WP-002) and WI-10/domain (WP-007). Use the existing worker resource selector and EffectInputRef for requested profile/inputs; bind selected profile, adapter, executable/dependencies and configuration through ResolvedEffect and reviewed typed immutable artifact manifests. Record applied/observed controls through bounded versioned artifacts referenced by EvidenceRef, keeping requested, advertised, applied and observed values distinct. Represent image applicability explicitly as Known, NotApplicable or Unknown; process fixtures use NotApplicable without fabricated image digests. Enclosing-instance evidence is separate and does not establish worker isolation. Portable identity uses opaque provider/run/resource references, never host paths or PIDs. Bind through existing receipt/content references; no free-form metadata or new public worker protocol family. Implement and fixture-review this mapping; a demonstrated wire-compatibility gap requires an explicit narrow amendment. This staged decision supplies the shared definition prerequisite, without requiring the whole WI-02 parent before WI-10/domain design. It does not claim WP-002/WP-007 verification or any live runtime proof.

decision.proposal: Adopt the admission, evaluation-only, invalidation, quarantine and removal-readiness rules in the attached WI-10/domain proposal. The domain slice builds an offline typed inventory/admission/removal-readiness checker, never a live provider registration or deletion path. Require a justified admission criterion, mediation-cost assessment and complete descriptor/evidence contract. Ordinary use requires applicable qualification. Evaluation-only use requires explicit, exact fixture approval and cannot waive controls or self-promote a provider. Qualification binds the exact profile, adapter, executable/dependencies, configuration, environment, fixtures, results and reviewer evidence; relevant change or revocation invalidates it. Quarantine blocks new starts while retaining separately authorized inspection, termination and reconciliation. Removal remains blocked until exact replacement revisions, qualification, fixtures and applicable WI-06/WI-09 acceptance are evidenced. WP-007 remains synthetic definition-level verification with runtime_pass_asserted false. Current target catalog entries remain pending actual admission, and process profiles gain no VM/Kata or hostile-code qualification from naming or context. This approves the governance rules, not production admission, runtime removal, parent acceptance or test completion.
